changes: FIN's knob is RATE on every sound: the SMP RATE row, the tap of encoder B and the per-sound storage bit are gone, and so are the apply-sound gate, the switch snap and the two name gates.
FIN's parameter row names it RATE and Rate (knob, header, LFO destinations) and defaults to +63 (1x). A sound saved with FIN at +0 loads stopped.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
